sentence: This project builds up the testing ability of an animal disease laboratory for food-safety problems and antimicrobial resistance monitoring.
This project studies the basic mechanisms behind cancer development, including how normal and cancer stem cells work and how epithelial cancers start and progress.
This project studies how molecular processes wire the brain of an animal, tested in the nematode worm.
This project studies which signaling pathways shape the developing hippocampus, using fetal human hippocampus and organoids.
This project studies how the innate immune system interacts with bacteria that could become pathogens and how that shapes their evolution.
This project studies how immune cells inside a tumor change over time and space, using high-resolution lineage tracing.
This project supports the analysis of images of the brain and retina so that results can be repeated, including analysis with convolutional neural net approaches.
This project tries to improve aerosol flow where the airways split, so more drug reaches the lower lungs.
This project studies the immunological, genomic and metabolic features of people at risk of lupus who later develop the disease.
This project provides technical support to researchers who study diabetes mellitus.
This project tests how different memory systems and reward learning together help keep binge eating going in people with binge-eating disorder.
This project coordinates a group of teams that build and check pangenome representations and tools for the human pangenome.
This project studies the psychosocial effects of advanced head and neck cancer, and their biological and social causes, in patients receiving immunotherapy.
This project tests whether disrupting a signaling pathway that is turned up by a high fat diet can treat colorectal cancer linked to obesity.
This project studies metabolic and neural changes in cells and networks and how energy metabolites like glucose, lactate, and creatine affect cognition.
This project tests whether timing chemotherapy to a circadian rhythm in the blood brain barrier helps treat brain metastases from breast cancer.
This project uses microfluidics models to test whether blocking signaling in endothelial cells reduces thrombosis in myeloproliferative neoplasms.
This project compares how glutamate and dopamine are released from neurons and what controls that release.
This project builds a thermostable subunit vaccine against measles that is safe for severely immune compromised people.
